div.div: 2 شَبَّعَتْ غَنَمُهُ , (S, K, [in some copies of the former, erroneously, شَبِعَتْ,]) inf. n. تَشْبِيعٌ; (K;) and شُبِّعَتْ; (as in one place in the TA;) (tropical:) His sheep, or goats, were, or became, nearly, but not quite, satiated, or satisfied. (S, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
